snippet.title: SLIDING BEARS - UPDATE - August 2024
snippet.description:
🐻‍❄️SLIDING BEARS is now available in 9 languages! 🐻‍❄️

❄️LAST UPDATE❄️
• Our game is now available in 9 languages! (English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Dutch, Polish, Portuguese & Brazilian Portuguese).
 • We’ve upgraded our bots bear AI. Be careful, they are much more vicious now...
• Keep track of your overall score when playing multiple times in a row!
• Obstacles now have multiple setups, so every game feels less repetitive.
• Your settings are now saved when modified.
• Other minor changes to make the experience smoother!

AVAILABLE ON STEAM: store.steampowered.com/app/3047570/Sliding_Bears
Instagram: @sliding_bears_games
Tiktok: sliding_bears_games
